login.title: Sign in to Budgetly
login.description: We'll email you a link to sign in. No password needed.
login.sent: Check your inbox: we sent a sign-in link to {email}.
login.failed: We couldn't send the link. Try again in a minute.
login.linkInvalid: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Check your app and try again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcomeBody: Record your first expense or income: your monthly figures, trend and breakdown will appear here.
dashboard.trendDescription: Income, spending and saving per month, your part of shared accounts.
dashboard.breakdownDescription: Spending and saving by group and category. Open a row to see its transactions.
dashboard.breakdownEmpty: No spending or saving recorded this month.
dashboard.breakdownEmptyFiltered: Nothing recorded for this person this month.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.intro: Every transaction belongs to an account. Mark an account as shared when you co-own it: reports then count your share of what it spends.
accounts.sharedHelp: You co-own it with someone else. Reports count your share of its expenses and ignore money paid into it; its balance stays the real amount.
accounts.shareInvalid: Enter a share between 0.01 and 100, with at most two decimals.
accounts.relativeBalances: Balances are the net of the transactions recorded here, so they match your bank only if you started recording from zero.
accounts.flowsDescription: Money moved from one of your accounts to another, all time.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: Categories say what a transaction is for and belong to a group. Saving groups count apart from spending in your reports.
categories.beneficiariesHelp: Who a transaction is for, whatever its category: filter the dashboard by them to see, for example, what the children cost.

tags.title: Tags
tags.empty: No tags yet. Add one to a transaction to group it with others, such as a trip or an event.
tags.noTransactions: No transactions use this tag any more.

settings.title: Settings
settings.themeDescription: Light, dark, or follow your device.
settings.securityDescription: Protect your account with an authenticator app.

security.title: Two-factor authentication
security.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
security.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Check your app and try again.

entry.invalidAmount: Enter an amount above zero, with at most two decimals.
entry.name: Name
entry.receivedHint: Leave empty when it equals the amount sent.
entry.needTwoAccounts: A transfer moves money between two of your accounts. Add a second account first.

errors.NOT_FOUND: This item no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.CATEGORY_DIRECTION_MISMATCH: This category is for the other type (expense or income). Pick another one.
errors.CATEGORY_IN_USE: Transactions still use this category. Move them to another category first, or rename it instead.
errors.TRANSFER_LEG: This is part of a transfer: change it as a transfer.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT: This was already saved. Close the form and check the list.
errors.INVALID_CURSOR: The list changed. Refresh the page.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Some fields are invalid. Check the form.
